note: validateForm() checks 7 rules (REQ-RD-001/002 recipient details, REQ-AK-001..005 acknowledgement/opt-outs/signature); the boolean agreed===false counts as empty identically to unanswered. detectAdditionalFlags() is a fully independent layer, including a length-based check on the typed name (1-2 characters is flagged as incomplete even though it satisfies the bare non-empty requirement).

personas.name: Blank notice with an implausibly short typed name
personas.description: Recipient details, both opt-out preferences, and the typed date are all blank; the acknowledgement checkbox is unchecked; the only text entered is an implausibly short typed name ('Al', 2 characters) - which satisfies the bare non-empty REQ-AK-004 rule but is independently flagged as incomplete. Six of seven rules fire (everything except REQ-AK-004), giving completeness 14% and status Incomplete. Three flags fire: two high (acknowledgement not given; recipient details missing organisation and recipient name), one medium (the implausibly short typed name).
